title: Selvage Session Protocol — every method of `selvage/1`
description: The three client-to-server methods, with the params each takes and the result each returns. Valid against PROTOCOL.md §5. The mapping is: `session.hello` → `sessionHelloParams` and no response frame at all (its result is the `room.created`/`room.joined` event); `doc.open` → `docOpenParams`, result `documentSet`; `doc.close` → `docCloseParams`, result `documentSet`. An unknown method is answered with an error response and never dropped.

anyMethod.description: A method name: one of the three above, an `x.`-prefixed reserved name (§10.1), or any other string at all. A name the server does not implement is answered with `unknown_method`; it is not a malformed frame.

anyParams.description: Method-specific params. Absent is equivalent to `{}`, and for a method that requires a member both are answered `bad_params`. Params are not `null`: an explicit `null` is a malformed frame (CANONICAL.md §2.6).

awareness_client_id.description: The awareness client id this connection will speak with. Omitted means this connection publishes no awareness, and the server then omits `awareness_client_id` from its `PeerInfo`.

capabilities.description: What the client believes it has. The server ignores any it does not know.

client.description: Free-form client identification, for diagnostics only.

display_name.description: Non-empty after trimming and at most 32 UTF-16 code units (PROTOCOL.md §5), so an astral character costs two; `maxLength` counts Unicode code points, so an implementation that enforces the protocol's bound counts UTF-16 code units itself. The server answers `bad_params` for a blank or longer name, and never truncates one. The only identity in this slice.

role.description: A claim, not a command: it is honoured only while the room is between host connections, and a connection that mints a room is its host whatever it claims (§9).

anyResult.description: Every result `selvage/1` has: the room's open-document set. `session.hello` answers with an event instead of a response, so it has no result here.
